messages:
morgan: heads up — merged the constraints PR a few mins ago and CI went red on linux builders. looks like a cached wheel with an unexpected platform tag got pulled and then the build fell over.

morgan: logs:```
ERROR: Could not install packages due to an OSError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'openssl/opensslv.h'
Looking in indexes: https://pypi.org/simple
Found cryptography-38.0.4-cp310-cp310-manylinux_2_17_x86_64.whl in cache
Skipping wheel build for cryptography, since already cached wheel incompatible with this platform
```

esther: ugh. is that the job that uses our manylinux2014 image? @devops which runner tag is this one using? :thinking_face:

devops: that job uses `redwood-builder:2024-05` which expects manylinux_2_17 wheels. we updated the image last week but the cache on the CI workers still has older wheels.

liam: try `pip cache purge` in the job and re-run — cache mismatch is common after image bumps. also can you paste the exact pip args the job uses?

morgan: job uses `python -m pip install -r requirements.txt --prefer-binary --no-build-isolation` (we surface prefer-binary via constraints). i can ssh into a failing runner and clear cache, but would rather a quick repro locally first.

sam: one thought — the constraints PR bumped a transitive dep (cffi) which toggled a different wheel resolution path. could be that prefer-binary + cache returns an older manylinux tag.

morgan: tried locally: `pip install -r constraints.txt --no-cache-dir` — that avoided the cached wheel but then pip attempted to build from source and failed with missing system header (openssl). so two issues: cached wrong wheel on CI, and our image lacks libs for building when wheel not available.

esther: ok actionable: (1) clear pip cache on CI runners or make install use `--no-cache-dir` for the short term; (2) ensure builder image has dev deps for openssl; (3) consider pinning problematic transitive to a known-good wheel.

devops: i can add a one-off step to purge `/root/.cache/pip` before install and kick the job. will also spin a new builder image with libssl-dev.

ci-bot: triggered rebuild #3421-retry — queued by @devops

morgan: rerun came back green on linux after purge + new image. macos job still had a flake (timeout while building cryptography from source).

liam: for macos we probably need a prebuilt wheel or we add `libressl` pkg in the runner. short-term I'd rather pin cryptography to the last wheeled version in constraints so CI doesn't try to build.

esther: okay please open a PR to revert the transitive bump and add a follow-up issue to harden CI around cache+image upgrades. also add a note to the ops runbook about clearing pip cache after builder updates.

morgan: opening PR now: revert-transitive-cryptography-bump + runbook note. cc @liam will add the pin in the PR as a stopgap. :sparkles:

sam: thanks — once PR is up i'll do a quick smoke run and then we can merge.

morgan: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/revert-transitive-cryptography-bump — includes CI tweak to purge pip cache on the affected job.

esther: nice, thanks. let's follow up in retro on how the constraints workflow missed this cache/image coupling. :+1:
